signal_rules.reads: Wikipedia page views of the title's article(s), per day (English + Indian editions when stored): absolute reads, free. Someone who opens the article went looking. Needs 2 of the last 3 days.
signal_rules.search: Google Trends search interest for the title, last 7 days, on Google web and on YouTube search (SerpApi). Each value is the title's interest as a ratio to 'netflix' searched in the same batch, so batches and days compare. ↑ = last 2 days ≥ 25 % above the 5 before (the title's own change).
signal_rules.views: The trailer's YouTube views day over day — exact (YouTube Data API) when a key is set, else as the daily search last showed them. Before a second snapshot, ≥ 250,000 views a day since upload counts as ↑. A gain must clear 10,000 and 1 % (or 100,000) to count.
signal_rules.verdict: Two of three must be known: reads ↑ + another ↑ = really trending · search ↑ + views ↑ = searched and pushed · views ↑ alone = pushed, not pulled · search or reads ↑ with views not up = searched, not pushed · reads ↓ + search ↓ = fading. One signal ↑ alone = 'rising' (a hint, not a verdict).

last_run.note: search interest: 14 searches, 56 curves · YouTube API: no key (YOUTUBE_API_KEY)

rules.views: YouTube views of the title's videos when last searched (SerpApi, gl=IN) — attention, not viewing on the platform. A row is one title: its videos' views added up; the best video is the one linked
rules.pace: Views a day since upload (views ÷ days since the upload, half a day at least), added over the title's videos — the push, not the age. The list is ordered by it
rules.gain: Views gained since the day before (the same video found again on the next daily search)
rules.india: India only: searches run for India and a video counts for a platform only on its Indian official channel (own) or a broadcaster partner's channel feeding it (TV promo)
rules.scope: Default = launch material (trailer, teaser, first look, now streaming, launch promo, recap). Daily serial promos, episode previews, songs and clips are behind 'Clips' and never set the KPIs
rules.budget: XST_TRAILERS_MONTHLY SerpApi searches a month (default 500): 60 % for the daily platform searches, 40 % for the search-interest curves, each spread over the days left in the IST month; the bulk sweep is separate and only on request
rules.google: On Google now: the title is on Google's Trending-now lists (India or a state) in the latest Search Trends rows — rank, heat and verdict from that page. '—' = not trending on Google right now (free data; no call)
rules.published: Upload day from YouTube's relative date at search time ('2w ago' = 14–20 days: the row keeps the range and says when it may be older than the window)
